tool_input.description: Make lookup counter atomic and run price cache tests three times

tool_input.command: for i in 1 2 3; do dotnet test --configuration Release --filter "FullyQualifiedName~PriceCacheTests" 2>&1 | tail -4; done
tool_input.description: Run price cache tests three times

result:
- **Cause:** A real bug from this MR's commit (741337d), not a flake. It moved `_lookups++` out of the lock in `PriceCache.GetOrAdd`, so parallel lookups lose increments (124 of 128 counted).
- **Action:** In `src/Storefront/Pricing/PriceCache.cs`, I made the counter atomic: `Interlocked.Increment` in `GetOrAdd`, `Interlocked.Read` in `Lookups`, `Interlocked.Exchange` in `Clear`. Price resolution still happens outside the lock. I did not change the test.

The 4 `PriceCacheTests` pass locally. The change is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline stays red until you push it.

One other thing could still turn the pipeline red: `CatalogTests.Catalog_ReturnsListPrice_ForKnownSku` failed in my full local run (40 of 41 passed). It is unrelated to this MR and Xping already lists it as known flaky. `PromotionTests` leaves a promo price for `MUG` in the static cache, and `CatalogTests` doesn't clear the cache, so it fails when it runs after that test. Making `CatalogTests` inherit `StorefrontTestBase` should fix it; I left it alone to keep this MR scoped.

`xping report` also shows `Checkout_NumbersInvoicesUniquely_WhenCheckoutsRunInParallel` failing in the 10:04 run of this commit (known flaky in cloud). It passed in my local run and I did not look into it.
